journalSql: select "events"."id", "events"."kind", "events"."project_id", "projects"."uuid" from "project_sync_events" as "events" left join "projects" on "projects"."id" = "events"."project_id" where "events"."workspace_id" = ? and "events"."id" > ? and ("events"."project_id" is null or exists (select 1 from "projects" where "workspace_id" = ? and "projects"."id" = "events"."project_id")) order by "events"."id" asc limit 101
